name: Colors
description: Pick any color on your screen and copy it as HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS or SwiftUI.
whatsNew: Explains itself on its page in Settings.

howTo.goal: Picks any colour on your screen and copies it in the format you need: HEX, RGB, HSL, CSS or SwiftUI.
rules: Press Pick, then click anywhere on the screen.
Recent colours stay in the list to copy again.
